reason: I get my Monin with the rest of the order from the distributor, it's always there and it tastes the same every time. At 23 euros a litre, about double what I pay for Monin, I'm not putting a small producer's syrup on the menu and risking a cocktail I can't make in high season.
objection: A small producer might run out in high season, and a fermented syrup could taste different from one batch to the next. If a signature cocktail is built on it and it runs out, I'm stuck.
would_change_my_mind: Getting it through my usual distributor, with guaranteed stock all season and the same taste every batch, at a price closer to 15 euros a litre. I'd take the free sample to taste it, but that alone won't make me order.
